research_question: Does an aligned H1 FVG under causal H4 bias that follows through by creating the first subsequent same-direction H1 FVG within 12 H1 bars produce a profitable continuation edge toward the nearest already-confirmed H1 swing target on the OANDA NAS100_USD CFD proxy?

source_backed_semantics.bias_context: FVGs can be used to frame bias, narrative and context.
source_backed_semantics.consolidation_warning: If the first subsequent FVG is opposing rather than same-direction, the initial FVG did not follow through and the market is treated as consolidating.
source_backed_semantics.follow_through: An FVG follows through when price creates a new FVG in the same direction; this restores trust in that directional argument.
source_backed_semantics.target_context: The first opposing PD Array can act as a swing point / resistance context; V8 uses a causal H1 swing target as an explicit engine convention rather than claiming the source supplied a machine target rule.
